Catching Pokémon.description: From "I caught a thing" to "I can make the exact Pokémon appear".

Sleep On It.description: Catch a Pokémon that's suffering a status condition (Sleep, Paralyze, Freeze, Burn, or Poison).

Right Tool, Right Job.description: Catch a Water- or Bug-type Pokémon with a Net Ball.
